text:
Ana: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API portfolio. Sales pushed three customer asks this week: cheaper embeddings for batch exports, a rerank bundle with per-request pricing, and tighter chat latency for mobile apps.
Mike: can we quantify impact? like delta in p99 / cost for each option.
Sara: embeddings customers are mostly vector DB vendors — they care about p99 and tail cost. One large customer estimated 2x cost right now on their workloads.
Kevin: infra note — lowering embed p99 to 50ms would need new instance profiles + KV cache hot-paths. Rough rough: +15-25% infra cost unless we change model quantization or shard differently.
Jess: from product/ux: customers expect same API shape. If we do a pricing bundle for rerank we need clear SLA & sample billing calc in docs.
Ana: proposal A = infra investment (reduces p99, broader win). Proposal B = product-side bundles + beta access (faster, cheaper to ship but narrower coverage). Need to pick one for OKR slate.
Mike: tradeoffs: A delays other roadmap items (chat long-context + streaming perf). B risks confusing API surface and adding billing complexity.
Sara: also could do hybrid: infra pilot for top-2 customers + bundle for others. Pilot helps us collect perf signals.
Ana: launch criteria idea (rough):
```
- pilot customers onboarded (2)
- embed p99 improvement >= 30% for pilot workload
- rerank bundle billing docs + example calculations
- regression run: no >1% quality drop on eval set
- runbook and fallback policy configured
```
Mike: can devs hit those by mid-Q2? dev estimate: 6w for cache and infra, 3w for billing/docs + canary.
Kevin: SRE ops checklist: autoscale rules, throttles, region routing and fallback to smaller models. I can spin up canary infra but need budget approval.
Jess: design will need sample error states + pricing explainer. I'll sketch flows this week.
Ana: prioritization ask — vote: pick one of three lanes for the hosted-api slice for OKR (1) Infra-first (2) Product-bundle-first (3) Hybrid pilot. Reply with 1/2/3 and one-sentence rationale.
Mike: 1 — infrastruture-first. Longest runway for customers; consolidated perf wins.
Sara: 3 — hybrid. Lowers risk and buys data.
Kevin: 1 — infra-first but move pilot capacity for top customers in parallel.
Jess: 2 — bundle-first. Fast win for comms + revenue experiments.
Ana: tally so far: 1(2), 2(1), 3(1). Need PM+Eng alignment.
Mike: engineering constraint: if we do 1 we should defer streaming perf item by one sprint. Heads-up to infra planning.
Ana: next steps:
- Mike to write FTE + infra budget ask by Wed
- Kevin to draft ops runbook + canary config by Thu
- Sara to pull customer usage histograms and cost model
- Jess to draft pricing explainer & error states
- I'll aggregate and present at Friday roadmap huddle
Kevin: deploy-bot note: canary cluster slots available in q2-labs. Use label `hosted-embed-pilot`.
deploy-bot: Canary slots reserved: 2 clusters tagged `hosted-embed-pilot`. Use `--canary=hosted-embed-pilot` on deploy.
Sara: one more data point — embeddings compute per token not linear; we should include long-tail vectors in costs. I'll add that to the model.
Ana: perfect. If anyone objects to hybrid approach as fallback, flag now — otherwise I'll move the hybrid as fallback option in the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
Mike: no objections from eng.
Jess: ok from design.
Sara: fine.
Kevin: fine.
Ana: thanks — will post the roadmap draft after I get the budget ask.
Mike: ping me if you want the perf microbenchmarks run earlier.
Ana: will do.
